decisionsTitle: «Locuri păstrate pentru club», the release of the unsigned places at the deadline, a summary before every change of the places, and «Istoric capacitate»'s writes
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-04, for the 21 November race:** the site should register until the capacity less the places he keeps for the club, and he gives those himself; and he wants to see when, by whom and why the number of places changed. And, the same day: «la termen, locurile celor care n-au semnat să se elibereze, fără să le primească cineva automat», and — after a near-save of 175 → 190 places with twenty people waiting — «Controlul înscrierilor e foarte sensibil». The design is `places-design-2026-11-04` (four controls, two lanes, its critic's corrections overriding it); this section is lane A: (1) the kept places, (2)'s writes, (4) the release at the deadline, and the editor's summary before any change of a place setting. The plan page and the history's screen (3), (2) are lane B, which reads the rows written here.

**Decision — (1) «Locuri păstrate pentru club».** `events.places_kept_for_club` (K, 0 by default, at most the capacity, 0 on an uncapped event; two CHECKs) is a threshold on the entry's channel inside the one allocator (`registrations/domain/kept-places.ts`), never on `kind` and never a second capacity formula: a **public** entry — the form, its emailed link for another person, a family's form, a restart, the confirmation of a row the form wrote — takes a place only while fewer than `capacity − K` are taken (`placeForNewcomer`, read off the row after the sweep, `readPlaceRules`), and the waiting list's automatic offers («Da») fill only up to `capacity − K` (`fillAvailableSpots`' one gate counts `max(capacity − K − occupied, 0)`; the job's free-place sweep selects only such room). Every staff verb counts against the whole capacity — the staff entry and the desk (still behind anybody waiting, §615/§872), «Trimite-i oferta», «Oferă-i un loc acum», «Dă-i un loc acum», «Mută pe lista oficială», «Dă-i un loc», an invitation — so a kept place is given with **no** supplementary place while one is free; §642's +1 happens only when nothing at all is free. Invitations: the waiting list claims only the site's places, `max(capacity − occupied − min(waiting, max(capacity − K − occupied, 0)), 0)`, identical at K = 0. A place freed while `capacity − K` or more are taken stays the club's — a public runner's cancellation included — so once the kept places are given the reserve grows back. «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» stays as it is (the case «K = everything»). `computeOccupied`, `hasDirectAvailability`, `computePublicAvailability`, each staff verb's own check and the places alert are untouched; K only lowers the number a public entry and the automatic offers are compared with, so it can never seat one too many, and every decision stays under the event lock. Defaults change nothing: with K at 0 every function is the identity and every existing test passes unchanged.

**§160 with K (the critic's correction 3).** A lapsed declaration hold is released only as far as people want places, measured on the room they would be given from: the site's room `max(capacity − K − occupied, 0)` for the line and a public newcomer — clamped as `free` always was, so no input releases more holds than people want places — and the whole capacity for a staff newcomer (`expireStaleHolds`' `wantingChannel`). A public newcomer is never the reason a hold goes while the club's kept places are in use (more taken than `capacity − K`): the place would be the club's again, not theirs; the public count and the door's own check (`occupiedForNewcomer`'s `keptInUse`) read the lapsed holds as free only in that same case. What remains, documented: once the kept places are given out, a §160 release on «Da» can refill the reserve instead of serving the line.

**What the public and the staff are told.** The site announces `capacity − K` places — «N înscriși din 165 de locuri», «Toate cele 165 de locuri s-au ocupat» — on the card, the event page and the register page (the public cache's entry carries the announced capacity, its key gained `kept-places`), and nothing public names the reserve. Taken plus free is always the announced number; once the kept places are given, the page keeps saying «165 înscriși din 165» while «Cine vine» may count more (Q1's note). With K > 0 every sentence that promised a freed place reaches the line by itself says the organizers' words instead (`offerWordsByItself`, the public row's `keepsPlacesForClub`, `lineOffersOnItsOwn`, `offersWaitlistAutomatically`) — the allocator's gate is unchanged. The lapsed hold's next step, the family message's «pe lista de așteptare» and WAITLIST_JOINED's «este complet» measure a public newcomer on `capacity − K`. Backoffice: «Locuri» splits the free places — «Din ele, pe site: 2; păstrate pentru club: 10 din 10, le dai doar tu» (all the staff's while the tick is on) — and «Pe site acum» says «Pe site arată plin: au rămas doar cele N locuri păstrate pentru club» only while the page reads full by its own door (open dates and tick, no place of the site's own left), never beside a door closed for another reason (the critic's correction 5). The editor: the box «Locuri păstrate pentru club» under «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», with «Pe site apar acum 165 din 175» under it; the registration box's closed line says «păstrate pentru club: 10»; the event file carries it (written only when above 0), the diff names it, a duplicate and every date of a series copy it, a series save carries it like the capacity.

**(2) «Istoric capacitate»'s writes — the contract lane B reads.** Every save that moves the capacity or K writes, in its own transaction, one audit row per value that moved (`content/events/capacity-audit.ts#auditPlacesChange`, comparing the row before and after, so a mode or type switch that nulls the capacity is recorded rather than refused): `event.capacity_changed` `{from, to, occupied, offered, via, reason?, version}` and `event.places_kept_changed` `{from, to, via, reason?, version}`, `entity_type = 'event'`, the actor the staff member — the editor (`editor`), each date of a series save (`series`), an event file's import (`import`), a create (`create`), a duplicate (`duplicate`) and the dates a series makes (`series_generated`, no actor when the job made them). `occupied` is counted under the event lock whenever the places move; `offered` is the offers the raise made; `version` is the row's after the save and orders the changes whatever the clock said. The supplementary places keep their names (`event.capacity_raised_for_offer` / `_place_now` / `_invitation`) and gain `version`, `occupied` and, for an offer, `via` (`offer`, `offerNow`, `moveAndOffer`). «De ce schimbi locurile? (opțional)» under the places is stored, trimmed and cut to 200 characters, only on a row of a save that moved them — never a name.

**Lowering under the places taken.** Refused as before, now with the allocator's own counts (`CapacityBelowTakenError`, naming the `capacity` box, and the date of a series): «Locurile nu pot fi mai puține decât cele ocupate acum, 12: confirmați…, de semnat…, oferite…, invitați…, rezervate familiilor…» instead of «Verifică datele introduse» (BR-REQ-034-02 criterion 3). K above the capacity is refused naming its box, per series date too (`PLACES_KEPT_ABOVE_CAPACITY`), judged against the row's own K when the box is not posted. Before the press the capacity's help says «Ocupate acum: … Nu poți coborî sub …», and the waiting people's sentence follows the allocator: «Locurile noi nu se oferă singure: le dai tu din «Înscrieri»» on «Nu» or the tick, and, while kept places beyond the site's are in use, «Ai dat deja 3 locuri păstrate: la o mărire, primele 3 locuri noi rămân ale clubului; doar cele de peste se oferă imediat». Lowering K — or raising the capacity, or lifting the cap — is «the site's places grew» and offers the line its new room at once (§147).

**Left out on purpose.** A separate reserve with a marker on each registration (the threshold matches «until capacity − kept»); plain staff entries jumping the public line into kept places (§615/§872 stand); changing the places alert to count only the site's places (set N = K instead); backfilling the history from before this release (the screen shows gaps); refusing a switch that nulls the capacity (it is recorded); a pre-read K argument the callers must pass (`readPublicPlaces` reads it when absent).

**What the tests pin (lane A, part 1).** The allocator over capacity 10 with 3 kept — seven public places, then the line or a refusal like a full race, a staff entry taking a kept place while nobody waits, «Trimite-i oferta» and an invitation using one with no supplementary place, «Da» offering nothing above the threshold and the line's room when K is lowered, a family's form reserving only the site's places — and a door-against-allocator grid over K, the places held, a lapsed hold, the people waiting and the line's limit; the event page and the card announcing `capacity − K` and reading full, in the organizers' words, once only the kept places are left; the editor's box, its announced line, the taken places' help and «Nu»'s raise sentence; every save path's row with its `version`, and the three supplementary places' rows with theirs. The two-connection case (capacity 12, K 2, twenty public confirmations beside a «Trimite-i oferta» and a staff entry) asserts on the public channel's own allocations, as the critic's correction 21 asks, and runs in CI only.

**Decision — (4) «Eliberează singur locurile nesemnate la termen».** `events.release_unsigned_at_deadline` (off by default), a tick under «Termenul declarației» in the participation window's card, audited `event.release_unsigned_changed` `{from, to}`. On a scheduled, capped event with it ticked and a participation window whose deadline is strictly before the start (`registrations/domain/unsigned-release.ts`, days counted as 24 hours like `confirmationWindow`, its SQL twin `deadlineReleaseDueSql` held to it by a test), the first capacity-changing transaction at or after that deadline — normally the maintenance run the deadline wakes — releases, inside `expireStaleHolds` and under the event's lock, every declaration hold that holds a counted place and is past its own deadline, **whoever waits**: the existing `PENDING_DECLARATION → EXPIRED` with `DECLARATION_HOLD_LAPSED` (the release's `UPDATE` now guards that status), no new reason. Never a special guest's hold («În afara locurilor», released silently at the start as before), never one whose first email is still queued (§513), never an offer, a family's reservation or an invitation; a hold given or lapsing after it follows §160 again — no release is driven by the clock alone. A place a staff verb gives inside the window takes the window's deadline (`computeVouchedPlaceExpiry`), so the help says the release takes the unsigned places the staff gave too. It gives the places to nobody: in the same transaction (`registrations/unsigned-release.ts#completeDeadlineRelease`) it writes the deadline it ran for (`events.unsigned_released_for`, a memory column like `places_alert_sent`: no version bump, never posted, exported or copied), ticks «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» when it is off (version + 1, `event.free_places_by_offer_only_changed` `{from: false, to: true, via: "deadline"}`, no actor — the owner's Q2, so «fără să le primească cineva automat» stays true whatever the dates and «Da» say; the tick stays on, so every place freed later waits for him too, and he may untick it), and writes `event.unsigned_released` `{deadline, released, test, unsigned, free, waiting, offerOnlyTicked, via: "deadline"}`, no actor. Once per deadline: a second run finds the memory; a window moved to another deadline arms it again. A cancelled event is untouched; at or after the start every hold goes silently as before. It only moves holds to `EXPIRED` under the lock and only narrows who takes a free place, so it can never seat one too many.

**A signature at the deadline (the critic's correction 18, and the review's nit).** Whichever transaction reaches the deadline first runs the release — the job, a visitor's form, a staff press or the signature itself — so the answer must not depend on who locked first. A signing press asks first, under the event's lock and before it writes anything of its own, whether the release is due (`service.ts#releasedAtDeadlineFirst`: the token's transaction asks before it saves the posted answers of «Completează-ți datele», §905, and `signDeclaration` asks again before «Vreau să primesc oferte și beneficii», §562, and the signature). When the release, run there, took this very hold, the press saves no answer, no yes to the offers and no signature, re-allocates nothing, and returns rather than throws, so the release, its memory, its emails and the link's spend commit: the same outcome as a press that comes after the job's release (refused, nothing written), and the page then says the place is no longer held. Refusing the press with a throw was rejected: it would roll the release back with it, and the page would draw the form again until the job ran. A signature before the deadline keeps its place; one after the release finds the row `EXPIRED` and is refused; the desk's re-seat of a released runner is unchanged.

**The emails (the owner: «să nu spamez»).** Each person released gets the existing «Locul tău nu mai este rezervat» (`DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED`, §638), once per hold, with a third sentence chosen by the payload's `atDeadline` — «Termenul pentru semnarea declarației a fost {deadline}. Locurile celor care nu semnaseră până atunci au fost eliberate, așa că locul tău nu mai este rezervat.» — and **no club copy** (the critic's correction 14): the club hears of it once, in `UNSIGNED_RELEASED`, a new staff message to the `PLACES_ALERT` audience (every Administrator and Superadministrator with an address, in their own language; `placesAlertRecipients` now shared), keyed `unsigned-released:<event>:<deadline>:<staff>`, sent only when the release freed a hold or left one unsigned (correction 16): the facts line «Eliberate: 12 · libere acum: 14 din 175 · pe lista de așteptare: 20», then the holds still unsigned and why (special guests, a first email still queued, an own deadline after the window's) and the test registrations, never a name; that each person was emailed; who gives the places now — «Am bifat «Locurile libere le dau doar eu»; debifează-l…» or that it was already ticked; one button to the event's registrations. No `WAITLIST_SPOT_OFFER` leaves (the tick), no `PLACES_ALERT` (the alert only re-arms, so the owner's own later presses may send LOW and FULL again). A family address with several unsigned members gets one message per person, as for any release. The existing `toWaitlist` sentence becomes «…așa că locul tău a fost eliberat», true on «Nu» too. While the release is armed, the declaration's message and its last call say «Dacă nu semnezi până {deadline}, locul se eliberează și nu mai este rezervat pentru tine» instead of a place kept while nobody asks and a paper on race day (`releasesAtDeadline`, read by the renderer off the event's row).

**The job and the words in the backoffice.** `findEventsNeedingMaintenance` selects an event whose armed deadline has come with **no** «somebody waits» condition, and `next-work` wakes the job at the next armed deadline (`nextDeadlineRelease`), so the race's release runs within the job's cadence. The editor's help names the saved deadline, says the tick does nothing when the deadline is at the start or the places are unlimited, and that it ran, when it has; «Când se pierde un loc» says «La {due}, locurile celor care n-au semnat se eliberează toate…» while armed and «La {due}, locurile nesemnate s-au eliberat…» after. A duplicate, a series save and the dates a series makes never copy the switch (correction 16: each release emails everybody unsigned and every Administrator), and the event file carries it only when on. Accepted traps: a hold whose deadline an outage moved past the window's (§657) and one whose first email is still queued are not released by the run and follow §160; the summary counts only the real rows released in that one transaction. Left to whichever lands second with `feat/email-visibility`: the release's emails in their own `inEmailPress("job.deadlineRelease", …)` scope (correction 15).

**What the public pages promise (the critic's correction 7, the review's should-fix).** One rule, `domain/unsigned-release.ts#releaseTakesHold` — the release armed, a counted hold (never a special guest's), ending by the armed deadline — words every promise about an unsigned place: the declaration's message and last call; the signing page, «Locul tău este rezervat până {deadline}. Dacă nu semnezi până atunci, locul se eliberează, chiar dacă nu așteaptă nimeni…» instead of «Fără listă de așteptare rămâne al tău și după, până la start», and, once the armed deadline has come and the release has not yet run, «Termenul … a trecut: locurile celor care n-au semnat se eliberează, așa că locul nu mai este rezervat pentru tine» instead of «dar locul este încă al tău»; «Înregistrările mele»' «confirmă până» and «Ce îi spui», «Dacă nu semnezi până atunci, locul se eliberează» instead of the paper on race day. Before registering and right after it, the steps' declaration step and the screen after the form say the place goes at the deadline and drop the paper at the desk, read from the public row's `releasesUnsignedAtDeadline` (the switch on a capped event) with the window's deadline before the start; the editor's preview reads its draft. The journey's strip says the same (below).

**The words name the release's own deadline, and the journey's strip follows it (the review of 2026-11-04, round three).** The registration journey's strip (`RegistrationJourney`) takes the release's deadline as `release` and, while the release will take the place, its declaration step says to sign online by that deadline and that the place goes then — a released twin of each of its eight sentences per language, with no «sau pe hârtie la masa de înscrieri în ziua cursei» — on every page that draws the step: the signing page, the address confirmed and its link opened again, another person entered on the address and a family confirmed, an invitation accepted. The pages ask `releaseDeadlineOfHold` of the hold they read, or, after a press, `token-actions.ts#spentLinkReleaseMoment`: the person's own registration for their own links and an invitation's accepted registration (`event_invitations.accepted_registration_id`), and for a family's link, which names the address's registration rather than the person just entered, a hold given now (`releaseDeadlineForNewHold`: armed and still ahead — one given on the club's minutes so close to the deadline that they reach past it is told to sign online though the release would leave it: an under-promise, never the desk offered wrongly). Every sentence about the release names the release's deadline, never the hold's end, which a place taken inside the window on the club's minutes reaches earlier (kept past it only while nobody waits, §160): the signing page says «Locul tău este rezervat până {hold}; dacă așteaptă cineva, după aceea poate trece mai departe. Dacă nu semnezi până {release}, locul se eliberează, chiar dacă nu așteaptă nimeni…» when the two differ and the one sentence when they are the same instant, and «Termenul, {release}, a trecut…» once it has come; «Înregistrările mele» and «Ce îi spui» choose by `confirmByKey` — «…până {due}. Dacă nu semnezi până {release}, locul se eliberează.» when the hold ends first; the declaration's email names `releaseDeadlineFormatted`, each half in its own words, and says the hold's own instant only for the waiting list («Dacă se formează lista de așteptare, locul îți este ținut până …»). «Înregistrările mele»' row and the backoffice detail carry `releaseDeadline` instead of a yes or no. While the release is due and has not yet run, the signing page draws no form — its press would be refused by design — only the event and «Termenul … a trecut», and no strip: what the link answers once the run has released the hold, said a few minutes early. A family's wizard standing on such a person waits for the run, after which the person reads as released and the wizard moves on.

**«Controlul înscrierilor e foarte sensibil» — the summary before a save.** Before the event editor's save commits a change to any place setting — the capacity, the waiting list's choice and limit, «Da»/«Nu», «Înscrieri publice deschise», «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», «Locuri păstrate pentru club», the release at the deadline, «Anunță-mă când rămân N locuri», and the window's days when they move an armed release's deadline — ActionForm's one confirm (`ConfirmSpec.placeChanges`, resolved at the press by `notice.ts#resolvePlaceChanges`, drawn as lines under the body by `ConfirmDialog`; no second dialog system) lists each change «before → after» in the editor's own labels, then what it does in plain words, worked out in the browser by the allocator's own pure rules (`content/events/domain/place-changes.ts`: `lineRoom`, `newcomerJoinsLine`, `offersOnItsOwn`) over the numbers the page read on the server — the places taken (`computeOccupied`), the people waiting, whether the dates let the public in: what the site will announce (`capacity − K`), the free places after the save, split into the site's and the club's; whether the first N waiting get an offer by email or nobody gets a place automatically; the site's button; a lowering under the places taken or K above the places said alone, as the refusal it will be; the release's deadline, «a trecut: se eliberează în câteva minute», no effect, off, or «a rulat deja: mutarea termenului nu aduce pe nimeni înapoi»; the alert. A save that changes no place setting asks nothing; the editor's other questions (the update notice, the cancellation) keep their title and carry the same lines under their body. It replaces the narrower «Locurile noi se oferă pe email» question. Only on a saved, scheduled event this site registers, for whoever may save its settings; a JSON import over an event shows its own diff instead.

**«Emailuri»'s forecast honours K and the release (the critic's correction 4).** The offers to the next in line are foreseen only as `offerFreedPlaces` makes them (`automatic-sends.ts#lineOffersMade`): none on «Nu» or with «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», and with places kept for the club none until the places taken beyond the site's are made up — the first `max(occupied − (capacity − K), 0)` releases free a place that stays the club's. An armed release in the horizon lists one lapsed-hold email per counted hold due by the deadline, at it, and one `UNSIGNED_RELEASED` per Administrator, and no offer from it or after it.

**The migration.** `0193_place_controls` (expand only: the message type, the three columns, the two CHECKs), numbered after the shipped `0191_elite_visibility` and `feat/email-visibility`'s `0192_email_press`, since the journal's tags must grow in its order (`tests/unit/db/migration-chain.test.ts`); it sorts last, with the latest `when`. Its snapshot holds 0191's columns and names 0191's as its parent until `feat/email-visibility` lands, when it is re-chained on 0192's.

**What the tests pin (lane A, part 2).** The pure release rules and the SQL twin over a grid of events and instants; the release on PGlite — nothing before the deadline, every counted hold after it whoever waits, a special guest's kept, one memory, the tick audited, the people told with the deadline and no offer, one summary per Administrator and none to the Organizer, the test rows apart, nothing on a second run, a moved window armed again, nothing unsigned meaning no summary, the switch off, a cancelled and a started event as before; a signer before kept, one whose press is the release released with the rest, one after refused; the job's wake and selection; the words of both emails and the declaration's; the forecast's release, «Nu» and K; the summary's lines for each setting in both languages, the unchanged save, the form's reading and the other dialogs; the history rows of both imports and of a standing repeat's date; one end-to-end spec (K typed in the editor, the summary, the event page full while kept places remain, run by CI); a two-connection case (CI only) of six transactions reaching the deadline at once; and, on the real clock, the signing page's sentence with the switch on, off and for a special guest, and while the release is due, in both languages, a press at the deadline with the answers and the offers' yes saving neither beside the same press kept by §160 with the switch off, «Înregistrările mele»' and «Ce îi spui»'s reading, and the steps' and the screen after the form's words; the journey's strip on every page that draws the declaration step, with the release and without it, in both languages, and the reader each page asks for every kind of link, a special guest's place and a release already run; a hold that ends before the release's deadline on the signing page, in the declaration's email and in «Ce îi spui»; and the signing page drawing no form while the release is due.

Amends §147, §160, §348, §513, §562, §589, §612, §615, §638, §642, §647, §654, §657, §665, §872, §892, §896, §905 and §906; BR-REQ-033-01, BR-REQ-033-02, BR-REQ-034-01, BR-REQ-034-02, BR-REQ-034-03, BR-REQ-035-01, BR-REQ-035-02, BR-REQ-036-03, BR-REQ-037-01, BR-REQ-050-02 and BR-REQ-080-01.
changelogLine: - **«Locuri păstrate pentru club», the release at the deadline and a summary before every change of the places** — the site registers until the capacity less the places the club keeps and announces only those, the waiting list's automatic offers stop there too, while every staff verb gives a kept place with no supplementary one; «Eliberează singur locurile nesemnate la termen» frees, once at the declaration's deadline, the places of everybody who has not signed, gives them to nobody, tells each person and sends the Administrators one summary, and the signing page, the registration steps on every page, the screen after the form, the declaration's email, «Înregistrările mele» and «Ce îi spui» say beforehand that an unsigned place goes at that deadline, naming it, with no paper at the desk; before a save changes the places, the waiting list, the site's door, the release or the alert, the editor says each change and what it does — the places announced, the free places on the site and kept, the offers that will leave; «Emailuri» foresees only the offers the allocator makes; every change of the places is recorded with who, when, why and how many were taken. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: With «Locuri păstrate pentru club» K on a capped event, a public entry (the form, its link for another person, a family's form, a restart, the confirmation of a row the form wrote) takes a place only while fewer than capacity − K places are taken, then joins the waiting list, or is refused like a full race when the list takes nobody; the public count, the card, the event page and the register page announce capacity − K places, taken plus free adds up to it, nothing public names the kept places, and K = 0 changes nothing (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Every staff verb — the staff entry and the desk (behind anybody waiting), «Trimite-i oferta», «Oferă-i un loc acum», «Dă-i un loc acum», «Mută pe lista oficială», «Dă-i un loc» and an invitation — counts against the whole capacity, so a kept place is given with no supplementary place while one is free; an invitation's free places are capacity − occupied − min(waiting, max(capacity − K − occupied, 0)); occupied never exceeds the capacity (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Lowering the capacity below the places taken is refused naming the capacity box with the allocator's counts — occupied, confirmed, to sign, offered, invited, reserved for families — and, on another date of a series, that date; K above the capacity is refused naming its box (and the date), judged against the row's own K when the box is not posted; nothing is written (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Every save that moves the capacity or K writes, in its own transaction, `event.capacity_changed` {from, to, occupied, offered, via, reason?, version} and/or `event.places_kept_changed` {from, to, via, reason?, version} — from the editor, each date of a series save, an import, a create, a duplicate and the dates a series makes — and the supplementary places' rows carry version, occupied and the offer's via; the reason is stored only on such a row, at most 200 characters (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

With places kept for the club, the people waiting have priority over later registrations for the site's places only: an invitation, «Trimite-i oferta» or «Oferă-i un loc acum» may give a kept place nobody holds while people wait, with no supplementary place, whereas a public entry, a family's form and a plain staff entry still join the waiting list while anybody waits (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

With K > 0 the waiting list's automatic offers fill places only up to capacity − K: a place freed while capacity − K or more are taken stays the club's and is offered to nobody; lowering K, raising the capacity or lifting the cap offers the line the site's new room at once; a lapsed declaration hold is released only as far as people want the site's places (never for a public newcomer while the kept places are in use), and every sentence that promised a freed place reaches the line by itself says the organizers give the places instead (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The editor's «Locuri păstrate pentru club» (empty is 0, saved as 0 on an uncapped event, copied by a duplicate and every date of a series, carried by a series save, exported and imported in the event file when above 0) shows the places the site announces under it, and «De ce schimbi locurile? (opțional)» under the places is kept on the history; «Locuri» on the registrations list splits the free places into the site's and the club's, and «Pe site acum» says only the kept places are left only while the page reads full by its own door (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
